utterance: Hi Chloe, I'm Dr —, one of the GPs here. Thanks for coming in. Before we get to antibiotics, I want to make sure we get the diagnosis right. Can you tell me in your own words what's been happening since yesterday?
reply: It started yesterday morning, so about a day and a half ago. It really stings and burns, especially right at the end, and I'm going constantly—every half hour—and only a little bit comes out so I have to rush. It is a bit cloudy and smells, but I haven't seen any blood.

awards.label: How long the symptoms have been present
Colour of the urine or any visible blood

utterance: That sounds uncomfortable — let's make sure there's nothing more serious going on. A few quick questions: Have you had a fever, chills, or felt hot and shivery? Any pain in your back or side, up under the ribs, or nausea and vomiting? And any vaginal discharge, itching, or irritation down there?
reply: No fevers or shivers, and I haven't noticed anything in my back, just a bit of an ache low down in my tummy. I'm eating normally and haven't been sick, and I haven't had anything like vaginal discharge or irritation either.

awards.label: Red flag excluded: Fever, sweats, chills or shaking
Red flag excluded: Pain in the back or sides (loins)
Red flag excluded: Nausea, vomiting or feeling generally unwell

utterance: That's reassuring. You mentioned a UTI "again" — how many times have you had one before, and when was the last one? Also, are you sexually active at the moment, and is there a new partner in the last few months? And can you tell me when your last period was — is there any chance you could be pregnant?
reply: I only had one other UTI about two years ago. I do have a boyfriend I've been with for a year, just him. My last period was about two weeks ago and it was normal, so I don't think there's any chance I'm pregnant.

awards.label: Red flag excluded: Whether she could be pregnant

utterance: Good to know. Just a few more background questions: Do you have any medical conditions — things like diabetes, kidney problems or kidney stones? Do you take your contraceptive pill every day without missing any? And have you taken any antibiotics recently?
reply: No, I don't have diabetes or any kidney issues, I'm on the pill and I don't miss it, and I haven't had any antibiotics this year.

awards.label: Antibiotics in the last few months

finding: Soft abdomen. Mild suprapubic tenderness. No guarding or rebound. No masses.
No renal angle tenderness on either side.

result: Leucocytes ++, nitrites positive, blood trace, protein trace. hCG not tested.
